title: Video-to-3D Kinematic Distillation & Intrinsic De-lighting
hypothesis: High-dynamic AI-generated video can be reverse-distilled into physically plausible skeletal motion (eliminating foot sliding < 0.3 cm/s) and de-lighted Albedo textures (DeltaE < 2.0), surpassing pure MoCap pipelines in naturalness.

test_cases.name: Armored Mech Ranger (Hard Surface)
test_cases.prompt: heavy sci-fi tactical mech ranger holding plasma rifle, weathered titanium plating, mechanical joints, flat neutral lighting
test_cases.focus: Rigid body contact, weapon grip interpenetration elimination

test_cases.name: Cybernetic Hunter (Cloth & Anatomy)
test_cases.prompt: cyberpunk scout character walking forward on metallic floor, flowing hooded trench coat, combat boots, cinematic studio lighting
test_cases.focus: Cloth micro-wrinkles, ground-contact foot sliding elimination

test_cases.name: Titanium Exosuit 360 Orbit
test_cases.prompt: futuristic biomechanical exosuit statue on pedestal, 360 degree turntable lighting, subsurface scattering carbon fiber
test_cases.focus: Geometric volume stability, zero perspective breathing distortion
